name: empty
title: Empty
description: What shows where a list has nothing in it yet: a dashed hairline with the brand corner, a Lucide icon in a #262626 tile, a Funnel Display title, one muted line and the actions that fill it.
use_for: A new board, a search with no results, a list before the first item.
never: Illustrations or the brand light inside it
An empty state with no way forward
A spectrum color for the icon
source: Derived from the guidelines: Funnel Display titles, DM Sans muted lines, the #262626 card fill, neutral hairlines and the brand's voice (short declarative sentences ending with a period). shadcn's empty for anatomy.

examples.name: Board
examples.label: An empty board
examples.content:
<!-- A new board with nothing saved yet, and the way to fill it. -->
<spyglass-empty class="max-w-160" heading="No creatives saved yet." description="Search for ads, product shots and UGC, then save the ones that work to this board.">
  <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-bookmark" slot="icon"><path d="m19 21-7-4-7 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v16z"></path></svg>
  <spyglass-button><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-search" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg>Search creatives</spyglass-button>
  <spyglass-button variant="secondary">Import from a link</spyglass-button>
</spyglass-empty>
